jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Clinical Implementation Specialist – Perioperative Services**

**Per Diem \| 4–40 Hours per Week Based on Go\-Live \& Rollout Needs**

About MedGEO

MedGEO is a health technology startup focused on bringing innovative technology into the operating room to reduce administrative burden, improve clinical efficiency, and allow healthcare teams to spend more time focused on patient care.

Our platform is used by hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and physician offices to optimize clinical workflows across operating rooms and procedural environments. Built by a team with decades of firsthand perioperative experience, MedGEO combines clinical expertise, technology, and innovation to address the real\-world challenges faced by frontline healthcare teams.

We are seeking dynamic, hands\-on individuals to join our growing team and help support customer implementations as MedGEO expands across healthcare organizations.

**The Role**

MedGEO is seeking a **Clinical Implementation Specialist with a minimum of 3 years of experience working in perioperative services**.

Candidates may come from a variety of perioperative backgrounds, including:

* Operating Room Nurse
* Surgical Technologist
* Sterile Processing Technician
* Perioperative or Procedural Services Specialist
* Other roles with significant hands\-on experience supporting surgical and procedural environments

As a Clinical Implementation Specialist, you will play a critical role in the successful deployment, training, go\-live, and adoption of MedGEO technology.

You will work directly with nurses, surgical technologists, sterile processing teams, perioperative leadership, administrative staff, and other healthcare professionals to ensure MedGEO is successfully incorporated into existing clinical workflows.

This is a **hands\-on, customer\-facing position**. During customer implementations and go\-lives, you may serve as one of MedGEO's primary onsite representatives and will be responsible for helping clinical teams understand the technology, successfully incorporate it into their daily workflows, and become comfortable using the platform independently.

Because every implementation is different, this is a **per diem position with hours ranging from approximately 4 to 40 hours per week**, depending on customer rollout and go\-live needs. Smaller deployments may require only several hours of support, while larger hospital or health\-system implementations may require multiple consecutive days or a full workweek.

Some travel will be required for customer implementations and go\-lives. Scheduling and anticipated travel requirements will be communicated in advance.

As MedGEO continues to grow, strong performers may have the opportunity to transition into a **full\-time position**, take on expanded implementation or customer\-success responsibilities, help build the implementation team, and participate in **company equity opportunities**.

What You'll DoClinical Implementation \& Go\-Live Support

* Support onsite and remote implementation of MedGEO across operating rooms, procedural areas, surgical centers, and related clinical environments.
* Assist with workflow assessments before implementation to understand how each customer currently manages surgical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, and related perioperative processes.
* Help incorporate MedGEO into existing clinical workflows while minimizing disruption to frontline teams.
* Support implementation planning, customer readiness, system rollout, and go\-live activities.
* Provide hands\-on support to users during initial deployment and stabilization.
* Identify workflow issues, adoption barriers, and implementation challenges and communicate them to MedGEO's internal teams.
* Assist with troubleshooting and problem\-solving during live clinical operations.

Training \& Education

* Deliver hands\-on training to OR nurses, surgical technologists, sterile processing personnel, clinical staff, and administrative users.
* Demonstrate MedGEO functionality and teach users how the platform fits within their existing workflow.
* Adapt training based on the needs, experience, and responsibilities of different user groups.
* Support customer onboarding and ensure users have the resources, training, and guidance needed for successful adoption.
* Provide refresher training and additional support when needed.
* Help identify and develop customer super\-users and champions who can support continued adoption.

Adoption \& Change Management

* Help clinical teams transition from existing processes to new MedGEO\-supported workflows.
* Observe how users interact with MedGEO during real\-world procedures and identify opportunities to improve adoption.
* Reinforce best practices and help users become comfortable incorporating the technology into their daily workflow.
* Work with customer leadership and MedGEO's Customer Success team to identify adoption gaps and areas requiring additional education or support.
* Help ensure that new workflows are practical, sustainable, and aligned with the realities of the perioperative environment.

Product Feedback \& Field Insights

* Serve as an important connection between frontline users and MedGEO's Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and leadership teams.
* Collect feedback from nurses, technicians, sterile processing teams, and other users regarding workflow, usability, and functionality.
* Document recurring workflow challenges, product issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Translate observations from the field into clear, actionable feedback for internal teams.
* Support rollout and validation of new functionality and workflow improvements.
* Assist with product testing and real\-world validation when needed.

Reporting \& Implementation Documentation

* Document implementation progress, customer feedback, workflow observations, training completion, and adoption issues.
* Assist with tracking utilization and other implementation metrics.
* Provide clear updates to MedGEO project and customer\-success teams regarding customer readiness, adoption, risks, and follow\-up needs.
* Maintain organized documentation related to customer implementations and go\-lives.

Candidate Experience \& Requirements

* **Minimum 3 years of professional experience working in perioperative services, an operating room, surgical services, sterile processing, or a closely related procedural environment.**
* Experience as an **OR nurse, surgical technologist, sterile processing technician, or similar perioperative professional**.
* Strong understanding of perioperative workflows and the realities of working within operating rooms and surgical environments.
* Familiarity with surgical documentation, supplies, implants, instrumentation, sterile processing, preference cards, and/or procedural workflows.
* Comfortable working directly with nurses, surgical technologists, sterile processing staff, physicians, clinical leadership, and hospital administrators.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to confidently train individuals and groups on new technology and workflows.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to remain calm and effective in fast\-paced clinical environments.
* Comfortable learning new technology and healthcare software platforms.
* Ability to communicate observations and customer feedback clearly to internal technical and operational teams.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to follow implementation plans and customer schedules.
* Ability and willingness to travel for customer implementations, training, and go\-lives.

Preferred Experience

* Prior experience implementing or supporting healthcare technology.
* Experience training clinical teams or serving as a clinical educator, super\-user, preceptor, or technology champion.
* Experience with healthcare software such as **Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, HST, SIS, CensiTrac**, or other perioperative or sterile\-processing systems.
* Experience supporting technology implementations, workflow changes, or process\-improvement initiatives.
* Experience working with implant\- or supply\-intensive specialties.
* Experience participating in hospital or ASC technology go\-lives.

Schedule

This is a **per diem / PRN position focused primarily on implementations, training, and customer go\-lives**.

Hours will vary based on customer needs and may range from approximately **4 to 40 hours per week**.

Some customer sites may require only several hours of onsite training or implementation support, while larger hospital or health\-system deployments may require several consecutive days or a full 40\-hour week.

Some travel will be required to support customer implementations and go\-lives. MedGEO will provide deployment schedules and anticipated travel requirements in advance whenever possible.

**Growth Opportunity**

MedGEO is at an early and exciting stage of growth. We are looking for individuals who want to grow alongside the company rather than simply complete individual assignments.

High\-performing Clinical Implementation Specialists may have opportunities to:

* Transition into a **full\-time role** as MedGEO expands.
* Take on larger or more complex customer implementations.
* Move into implementation leadership, customer success, clinical operations, training, or related roles.
* Help build and mentor MedGEO's growing national implementation team.
* Support deployments with leading hospitals and health systems across the country.
* Participate in **company equity opportunities**, where applicable and subject to company plans and approvals.

This is an opportunity for an experienced perioperative professional who enjoys technology, training, problem\-solving, and working directly with clinical teams—and who wants to help shape how new technology is introduced into the operating room.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $55\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 4\.0 – 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Opportunities for advancement

Application Question(s):

* Describe your familiarity with healthcare software applications (e.g., Epic, CensiTrac, etc.) and prior experience training others to use these applications.
* Please describe your experience working in perioperative services, including your role (e.g., OR nurse, surgical technologist, SPD technician, or similar), years of experience, and the types of surgical or procedural environments you have supported. Please also describe any experience you have training staff, implementing new technology, or supporting clinical workflow changes.

Experience:

* Hospital: 2 years (Required)
* Perioperative care: 2 years (Required)
* Software implementation: 1 year (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* Certified Surgical Technologist (Preferred)
* CNOR (Preferred)
* CSPDT (Preferred)
* RN License (Preferred)

Location:

* Rochester, MN (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Perioperative Implementation, Training & Support Specialist
jobs.description:
**Perioperative Implementation \& Training Specialist – Per DiemPosition Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Perioperative Implementation, Training \& Support Specialist to join our innovative healthcare technology team. In this pivotal role, you will lead the deployment of perioperative systems, deliver comprehensive training to clinical and administrative staff, and provide ongoing support to ensure seamless integration of our solutions into ASCs, hospital and OMFS procedural workflows. Your expertise will drive efficiency, optimize clinical outcomes, and enhance user satisfaction across perioperative settings. This is an exciting opportunity for professionals passionate about healthcare IT, system design, and data management to make a meaningful impact in acute care environments.

MedGEO is seeking an experienced **Perioperative Implementation \& Training Specialist** to support the implementation, training, go\-live, and adoption of MedGEO’s clinical technology across hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and procedural environments.

**Perioperative Experience Required:** This role requires prior hands\-on experience working in perioperative services, including operating room, procedural, or surgical environments. Candidates must be comfortable with perioperative workflows, clinical terminology, surgical team dynamics, and the operational realities of supporting clinicians in fast\-paced procedural settings.

This is a **per diem (PRN/as\-needed) role** ideal for a perioperative professional who understands the realities of the operating room and enjoys working at the intersection of clinical care, technology, workflow improvement, and education.

You will work directly with OR nurses, surgical teams, perioperative leadership, IT, supply chain, revenue cycle, and other stakeholders to integrate MedGEO into existing clinical workflows and ensure users are prepared and supported throughout implementation and go\-live.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Clinical Implementation \& Go\-Live**

* Support end\-to\-end customer implementations, including workflow assessment, implementation planning, training, go\-live readiness, onsite launch support, and post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Evaluate existing perioperative and procedural workflows and help determine how MedGEO can be effectively incorporated into day\-to\-day clinical operations.
* Support MedGEO workflows related to surgical documentation, supplies and implants, preference cards, intraoperative resource utilization, Smart Vision, and other platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with OR nurses, surgeons, surgical technologists, perioperative leadership, IT, supply chain, revenue cycle, and hospital administration.
* Identify workflow challenges, implementation risks, adoption barriers, and training needs and communicate them to the appropriate MedGEO teams.
* Provide hands\-on onsite and remote support before, during, and after customer go\-lives.

**Training \& User Adoption**

* Deliver engaging training and education to nurses, surgical technologists, physicians, managers, and other clinical and operational users.
* Develop a strong understanding of each facility's workflow and tailor training accordingly.
* Reinforce proper system use, workflow integration, and MedGEO best practices.
* Provide ongoing education, refresher training, and support for new and existing users.
* Identify adoption gaps and work directly with customer teams to improve utilization and workflow alignment.
* Help develop customer champions and super\-users who can support continued adoption within their organization.

**Clinical \& Product Feedback**

* Serve as a clinical liaison between customers and MedGEO's Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and leadership teams.
* Gather frontline feedback regarding usability, clinical workflow, product functionality, and opportunities for improvement.
* Translate clinical observations into clear, actionable recommendations for the MedGEO team.
* Support the introduction and rollout of new features, Smart Vision capabilities, analytics, and workflow enhancements.
* Contribute to training materials, workflow guides, implementation playbooks, and clinical best practices.

**Customer Success \& Value**

* Help ensure customers achieve strong adoption and measurable value from MedGEO.
* Support evaluation of improvements in documentation efficiency, supply and implant capture, workflow performance, accuracy, compliance, and operational efficiency.
* Help identify opportunities to expand MedGEO into additional operating rooms, service lines, departments, or facilities based on customer needs and demonstrated value.
* Build strong relationships with frontline clinicians and customer stakeholders to support long\-term customer satisfaction and retention.

Qualifications

* Clinical experience within **perioperative services, operating rooms, surgical services, procedural care, or another acute\-care environment** strongly preferred.
* RN, surgical technologist, perioperative educator, clinical informatics professional, or similar clinical background preferred.
* Strong understanding of perioperative workflows, medical terminology, clinical documentation, and hospital operations.
* Experience with clinical technology implementation, training, healthcare IT, informatics, process improvement, or workflow optimization preferred.
* Comfortable training and supporting clinical users in fast\-paced surgical and procedural environments.
* Ability to communicate effectively across clinical, operational, technical, and administrative teams.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies and translate technical concepts into practical clinical workflows.
* Experience with clinical research, clinical trials, bioinformatics, EHRs, healthcare IT projects, or hospital system integrations is a plus.
* Ability and willingness to travel to customer locations for implementations, training, and go\-lives.

**Schedule, Travel \& Growth Opportunity**

This is a **per diem / PRN position primarily supporting customer implementations, training, and go\-lives**. Hours will vary based on the size, scope, and needs of each customer deployment.

Go\-live assignments may range from approximately **4 hours to 40 hours per week**. Smaller sites may require only several hours of onsite implementation or training support, while larger hospitals or health systems may require multiple consecutive days or up to a full 40\-hour week during implementation and go\-live periods.

Opportunities to **travel** to support customer go\-lives and onsite training will be available as company brings on new customers. MedGEO will provide scheduling and travel requirements in advance whenever possible so team members can plan accordingly.

As MedGEO continues to expand, strong performers may have opportunities to transition into **full\-time roles**, take on greater responsibility within implementation and customer success, help build and grow the implementation team, travel to support major healthcare deployments, and participate in **early\-stage equity opportunities**, where applicable.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants more than a traditional clinical role and is excited about helping introduce new technology into the operating room, working directly with customers, and helping shape how MedGEO scales across healthcare organizations.

Pay: $35\.00 \- $70\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 4\.0 – 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Do you have prior hands\-on experience working in perioperative services, an operating room, or another surgical/procedural care environment? If yes, please briefly describe your experience.

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Perioperative care: 3 years (Required)
* Healthcare management: 1 year (Preferred)
* Hospital: 2 years (Preferred)
* OR: 2 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

License/Certification:

* CNOR (Preferred)
* Certified Surgical Technologist (Preferred)
* Ambulatory Care Nursing Certification (Preferred)
* RN License (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
